title: Turn back before distance hardens into pain
summary: Let better company and honest stillness teach the wandering mind how to settle. Let this stay near the next choice: keep this in front of you: take the overheated self back from distance until Naam becomes support.
lifeApplication: The moment you know you are drifting, stop, sit, breathe once, and return to Naam. Let support arrive before distance hardens into another wound.

source.shortMeaning: Distance deepens pain; Naam becomes the support for return.
